comment: PORT-40 (port ADR-066), port-only: Dale "Dink" Dawson, the cover athlete (bible §3), never in the ROM; the remaster adds him as an unlockable opponent after a ladder clear. Same fields as an opponents.json team, one player: in doubles he plays alone, two against one, fast enough ('speed' 30; a human runs at 24, the ladder's CPUs at 16 to 22) to cover the whole court. Loaded after the ladder as Opponents.DAWSON; Opponents.count() stays the ladder's 8.
intro: I'M ON THE BOX. LET'S PLAY.
taunt: THAT'S WHY I'M ON THE BOX.
concede: TAKE THE BOX. YOU EARNED IT.
quips: I WAS NEVER IN THE GAME.
TWO OF YOU, ONE OF ME.
